name: mascot end card with a CTA button
looks: The mark and wordmark settle above a short version line, then a round character mascot drops in and lands with a small bounce. A row of small icon badges fades in beneath it, and a bright rounded call-to-action button settles at the very bottom.
build: Mark/wordmark fade/scale in; the mascot drops in from above and settles with an overshoot-and-settle bounce (back.out, 1-2 small oscillations); the icon row fades in on a short stagger; the CTA button scales in last and holds.
sound: A soft confirm tone as the mark lands, a cheerful boing on the mascot's bounce, a light chime on the button.
prompt: Close on the mark and wordmark settling above a short version line, then drop a small character mascot in to land with a playful bounce, fade in a row of small icon badges beneath it, and settle a bright call-to-action button at the bottom.
